_note: Curated. Source: communitydragon/thresh.bin.json mSpellCalculations, cross-checked vs wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Thresh. All direct-damage abilities are Magic (standard support AP scaling).
_noteQ: Death Sentence: TotalDamage = BaseDamage + AP*APRatio. Single hook-land hit.
_noteW: Dark Passage: only calc is TotalShield (a shield on the ally who steps on the lantern, not damage). No damage in this slot -- correctly omitted.
_noteE: Flay: TotalDamage = EffectValue(index 1) + AP*APRatio -- resolvable now that EffectValueCalculationPart is supported (per T2d). Single push/pull hit. PAttackDamageMin/Max on the same spell object are Thresh's Flay-passive charged basic attack (BuffCounterByCoefficient(1.7) keyed on collected-soul count), a different mechanic bundled onto E's spell object by Riot's data, not E's own damage. M25 §11.G update (loop 108): the BuffCounter soul-stack gate is NO LONGER the blocker -- BuffCounterByCoefficient is now supported and fed by the ComboNode.UserStackCount ('몇 스택') knob (see Nasus Q). TYPE CORRECTION: wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Thresh confirms this bonus is MAGIC damage (the prior note's 'bonus AD' was wrong -- AD is a SCALING term, not the damage type). Formula: PAttackDamageMin = 1.7 x souls (+0% AD); PAttackDamageMax = 1.7 x souls + PassiveADRatioTT(90/120/150/180/210% by E rank) x AD, reached after 10s of not attacking. STILL DEFERRED (not the stack gap): it is a CHARGED, once-per-~10s attack (NOT every basic attack, so an always-on onHit would over-count), AND its calc lives in the E spell object while conceptually being a passive (cross-slot resolution). Modeling it needs the charge axis (min->max, like DistanceScaled) + a once-per-combo on-hit shape on TOP of the now-available soul knob -- a multi-axis curation left for a dedicated pass, not force-fit here.
_noteR: The Box (ThreshRPentaAbility): TotalDamage = EffectValue(index 1) + AP*APRatio (tooltipOnly flag is metadata only, doesn't block resolution -- same as other tooltip-flagged-but-resolvable calcs elsewhere in this project e.g. Nautilus P). Single wall-break hit per enemy that crosses a wall.
_noteP: Damnation (soul collection) itself has no direct damage calc -- CurrentSoulBonus is a stat-bonus tooltip display (StatValuePerSoul x souls = the bonus armor/AP per soul), not a hit. The passive's real damage effect (the Flay-passive charged empowered attack via collected souls) is the PAttackDamage pair documented under E above -- as of loop 108 its soul-stack term is resolvable (BuffCounter support + '몇 스택' knob), so it is no longer BuffCounter-blocked; the remaining barrier is the charged/once-per-combo shape + cross-slot calc location, deferred there. No P entry yet (honest, P2).
